note: Filebrowser Extra is the shipped EXAMPLE submodule that demonstrates how to add custom file metadata to Filebrowser listings. It has no config, routes, permissions or schema of its own. Two event subscribers do the work: MetadataInfoEventSubscriber listens on 'filebrowser.metadata_info' and injects a 'modified' column definition (title 'Modified', type integer); MetadataEventSubscriber listens on 'filebrowser.metadata_event' and, when the 'modified' column is selected, stores each file's mtime as a filebrowser_metadata_entity row (module='filebrowser_extra', name='modified'). Medium/hard tiers are grounded in whether that 'modified' column is actually contributed on the live site (dispatch the filebrowser.metadata_info event / module enablement), which is deterministic and needs no rendered listing.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal filebrowser_extra submodule demonstrate, and which two Filebrowser events do its event subscribers listen on?
evals.expected_output: It is an example of adding custom file metadata to Filebrowser listings: it adds a 'Modified' column showing each file's mtime. Its subscribers listen on filebrowser.metadata_info (to declare the 'modified' column) and filebrowser.metadata_event (to compute/store each file's modified value).

evals.prompt: Where does filebrowser_extra store the 'modified' file metadata it computes, and how is that record tagged?
evals.expected_output: It stores a filebrowser_metadata_entity per file, created/updated in MetadataEventSubscriber::createModified(), with fields fid, nid, name='modified', title='Modified', module='filebrowser_extra' and the serialized formatted mtime as content.

evals.prompt: Using filebrowser_extra as the template, how would I add my own custom metadata column to Filebrowser?
evals.expected_output: Write two event subscribers like filebrowser_extra: one on filebrowser.metadata_info that adds your column to $event->getMetaDataInfo()/setMetaDataInfo() (a key with title and type), and one on filebrowser.metadata_event that, when your column is in $event->columns, computes the value per file and saves a filebrowser_metadata_entity tagged with your module and column name.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a submodule contributes an extra file-metadata column to Filebrowser. Inspect the running site (e.g. dispatch the filebrowser.metadata_info event) and name the metadata column key that is contributed and the module that provides it.
evals.expected_output: The 'modified' column is contributed by filebrowser_extra. Dispatching a Drupal\filebrowser\Events\MetadataInfo event on 'filebrowser.metadata_info' yields a 'modified' key (title 'Modified', type integer) once filebrowser_extra is enabled.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Filebrowser is missing the 'modified' file-metadata column that the filebrowser_extra example module provides. Make that column available in Filebrowser listings.
evals.expected_output: Enable the filebrowser_extra module (drush en filebrowser_extra -y). Its MetadataInfoEventSubscriber then contributes the 'modified' column to the filebrowser.metadata_info event, so Filebrowser listings can show a Modified column.
